유튜브나 게임 방송에서 자주 사용되며 들었을 때 중국어처럼 들리기도 합니다.

card.title: Learn Trending Korean Slang: 줴줴이야
quotes: Have you heard 줴줴이야 (jwe-jwe-iya) on YouTube? Let's learn this slang!
줴줴이야 (jwe-jwe-iya) is a playful slang derived from the gaming term GG.
It originated as a playful variation of GG used in YouTube and gaming streams.
A: 이번 게임 끝났다. B: 아 줴줴이야~ (A: This game is done. B: Ah, jwe-jwe-iya~)
Use 줴줴이야 (jwe-jwe-iya) when you accept defeat playfully in a video game!
Save this post and share 줴줴이야 (jwe-jwe-iya) with your gamer friends!
card.caption: Want to sound like a native Korean gamer? Check out the trending slang 줴줴이야 (jwe-jwe-iya)! It originates from the gaming term GG and is used playfully on YouTube and streams when a game is over. Try using it next time you play games with friends!
